comparison.objective: Position and tighten a one-hand bar clamp around stacked boards so it supports itself with sufficient force.
comparison.physical_skill: Clamp insertion, bimanual stabilization, ratcheting or squeezing, and force generation.
comparison.success_condition: Pads surround the stack, alignment is preserved, clamp force reaches 20 N in later specs, and the released clamp hangs stably.
comparison.reason: This is the closest shared force-locking primitive, but it tests installing a clamp on workpieces. The candidate uniquely tests hex-key unlocking, fine collar tuning, setting retention, and repeated energy-absorption outcomes.
